q: According to the Red Book 2017, the Contractor may apply for a Taking-Over Certificate by giving a Notice not more than how many days before the Works will be complete and ready for taking over?
explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Red Book 2017, Sub-Clause 10.1.

q: According to the Red Book 2017, within how many days after receiving the Contractor's Notice must the Engineer issue the Taking-Over Certificate or reject the application?
explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Red Book 2017, Sub-Clause 10.1.

q: According to the Red Book 2017, which of the following is NOT one of the conditions for taking over the Works?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Notice of No-objection to the as-built records (if applicable)

choices.label: B
choices.text: The Performance Certificate has been issued

choices.label: C
choices.text: The Works are completed, including passing the Tests on Completion

choices.label: D
choices.text: The training under Sub-Clause 4.5 (if applicable) has been carried out

explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Red Book 2017, Sub-Clause 10.1.

q: According to the Red Book 2017, if the Contractor is prevented from carrying out the Tests on Completion for more than how many days by a cause for which the Employer is responsible, the Employer is deemed to have taken over?
explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Red Book 2017, Sub-Clause 10.3.

q: According to the Red Book 2017, after a deemed taking-over under Sub-Clause 10.3, how much Notice must the Engineer give of the date after which the Contractor may carry out the Tests on Completion?
explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Red Book 2017, Sub-Clause 10.3.

q: According to the Yellow Book 2017, the Contractor may apply for a Taking-Over Certificate by giving a Notice not more than how many days before the Works will be complete and ready for taking over?
explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Yellow Book 2017, Sub-Clause 10.1.

q: According to the Yellow Book 2017, within how many days after receiving the Contractor's Notice must the Engineer issue the Taking-Over Certificate or reject the application?
explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Yellow Book 2017, Sub-Clause 10.1.

q: According to the Yellow Book 2017, if the Contractor is prevented for more than how many days (continuous or in total) from carrying out the Tests on Completion by a cause for which the Employer is responsible, the Employer is deemed to have taken over?
explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Yellow Book 2017, Sub-Clause 10.3.

q: According to the Silver Book, the Contractor may apply for a Taking-Over Certificate by giving a Notice not more than how many days before the Works will, in his opinion, be complete and ready for taking over?
explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Silver Book 2017, Sub-Clause 10.1.

q: According to the Silver Book, within how many days after receiving the application must the Employer issue the Taking-Over Certificate or reject the application?
explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Silver Book 2017, Sub-Clause 10.1.

q: According to the Silver Book, if the Employer neither issues the Taking-Over Certificate nor rejects the application within the required period (and the relevant conditions are met):

choices.label: B
choices.text: The Taking-Over Certificate is deemed issued on the last day of that period

explanation: Эх сурвалж: FIDIC Silver Book 2017, Sub-Clause 10.1.
